image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a reusable cloth diaper (nappy). The main body is made of a soft, white, fleece-like material. It features blue patterned fabric trim along the top waistband and leg openings. Yellow elastic loops or tabs are visible on the sides. A small red and black tag with text/logo is sewn onto the lower left front panel. The diaper appears folded or bunched, showing its padded thickness.
